title: Want to escape heatwaves? These are the best places to buy property in France

title: Ulrich Siegmund, the rising star of Germany's far right, electrifies crowds and rattles Berlin
subhead: The lead candidate in the regional elections in Saxony-Anhalt, scheduled for September 6, could allow the far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) to govern a German state for the first time since the founding of the Federal Republic. Behind his polished and appealing exterior, this former air freshener salesman champions a radical platform.

title: The Suez Canal: Birth and death of a colonial myth
subhead: 'Suez, a historic canal' (1/6). In 1869, the creation of a maritime route linking the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea, operated by the French and the British, captivated Europe. Initially a symbol of colonial oppression for the Egyptian people, the waterway became a tool of emancipation when President Nasser announced its nationalization 70 years ago, on July 26, 1956.
